description: The GUI's entire Tauri surface is the protocol: one invoke (the app's `tau_command`, allowed by default for app-registered commands) and a listener for the coalesced `tau://event` stream. The overlay title bar's drag region additionally needs `core:window:allow-start-dragging`. The pilot/wdio permissions live in the separate e2e capability, generated only for `--features e2e` builds (sweep finding X1).
